name: thin drops above its rate
about: thin hz 10 lets through at most one continuous value per 100 ms on a link and never touches a note, a clock or a SysEx.
notes: t is in milliseconds. A continuous value (cc, bend, touch) is kept when it is the first, or when (t - t_kept) * hz >= 1000, where t_kept is the last one KEPT, not the last one seen.
One budget per link, shared by every continuous kind and channel, because the cap it models is a relay's per link cap.
t 30 and t 60 dropped: 300 and 600 are below 1000.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 40 and t 150: a note on and its note off pass. Thinning a note off leaves a note stuck.
t 199 dropped: (199 - 100) * 10 = 990, one millisecond short. Measured from the last KEPT, so had t 130 counted it would be 690 and still dropped, but t 200 below separates the two readings.
t 200 kept: (200 - 100) * 10 = 1000. Measured from the last SEEN (199) it would be 10 and dropped.
t 250 bend dropped: the budget is shared, (250 - 200) * 10 = 500.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 320: clock is never thinned.
